scope: Confirms the documented development workflow: `npm start` proxies /api to the API on port 5080, and cookies plus the antiforgery header survive the proxy.

steps.detail: GET http://localhost:4200/api/system/info returned the API system information (application=TraceForge AI, environment=Development)
GET http://localhost:4200/ served the application shell with <app-root> and no inline script
POST /api/auth/register via the dev server returned 201
GET /api/auth/me via the dev server returned 200 with the registered account, so the SameSite=Strict session cookie is first-party
POST /api/workspaces via the dev server returned 201 using the X-XSRF-TOKEN header from /api/auth/csrf
